additional_info.subject: 0467446 - ID0467446-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313508370048] Check on logs CRM:00472000477
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Connection to OCPP backend was constantly failing during that period. Without it, the user was unable to successfully authenticate to start charging.
I took a look in the router to check the network quality.
The "Fair to poor" SINR of 13 dB is the key indicator here. Even though the signal strength (RSRP) and basic quality (RSRQ) are good to excellent, the SINR suggests that there's a significant amount of
interference or noise
making it difficult for the charger to effectively use that strong, good-quality signal.
There is nothing do be done from service side, the problem is coming from the network provider.  I will proceed to close the ticket.
If this is a permanent problem I suggest to contact the network provider to see if they are able to support.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
